highlights: Your balance went from €6,655 a year ago to €2,228 now.
In 7 of the last 12 months more went out than came in.
Groceries rose to about €579 a month from €462, because you shop more often (8.2 trips a month, up from 6.5), not because baskets got bigger.
At its lowest your account was €425 below zero (8 March 2026), and it was that low on 3 days.
Hobbies went down, to about €103 a month from €148.

highlights: December 2025 stood out: you spent €4,382, about €1,678 above your usual €2,704.
Most of the extra was groceries (€620 above usual), fast food (€465 above) and restaurants (€461 above).
Your biggest single purchase that month was €392 on furniture, on 16 December.

ideas.title: Cook some ready meals at home
ideas.detail: You buy about 7.3 ready meals a month for about €44. Cooking half of them at home would save about €13 a month.
ideas.basis: Assumes half of your ready meals are cooked instead and a home-cooked portion costs 40% of a ready meal. Based on simulated receipt lines.
